WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT 
    f.film_id,
    f.rating,
    COUNT(*) as copies
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(copies) as avg_copies
  FROM film_copies
),
rating_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(copies) as avg_copies_per_rating
  FROM film_copies
  GROUP BY rating
),
with_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    fc.film_id,
    fc.rating,
    fc.copies,
    fc.copies - ra.avg_copies_per_rating as diff_from_rating_avg,
    fc.copies - oa.avg_copies as diff_from_overall_avg,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fc.copies DESC) as rn
  FROM film_copies fc, overall_avg oa, rating_avg ra
  WHERE ra.rating = fc.rating
)
SELECT 
  film_id,
  rating,
  copies,
  diff_from_rating_avg,
  diff_from_overall_avg
FROM with_diffs
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC
